behavioral_effects: Model tab of the chat controls gains a free-text Custom model input: Enter selects the typed model for the conversation and remembers it as an extra list entry across chats (persisted in the chat-mode store).
Default thinking effort changed from Off to High: the panel starts at High and the WS payload carries thinking_effort=high by default; Off now means 'omit the field, server default applies'.
compatibility_impact: No WS event or REST contract change: 'model' and 'thinking_effort' payload fields already existed. Behavioural default change: the client now sends thinking_effort=high on every turn unless the user picks Off, so the server-side AI_THINKING_ENABLED/AI_THINKING_EFFORT defaults are no longer reached from the chat UI except via Off; the zustand chat-mode persisted store gains a customModel field (additive, no version bump needed - persist merges missing keys from initial state).
follow_up: The effort options hint 'Off - Direct answer, no reasoning' is only true while AI_THINKING_ENABLED=False server-side; if that config ever flips, Off silently means 'server default' and the copy should change.
limitations: Shrink pass (4-agent simplify review) applied: replaced hand-rolled localStorage persistence with the existing zustand persist store, replaced a raw input with the ui FormField+Input primitives, removed a provably dead availableModels lookup and an idle useMemo, and centralised the high default in DEFAULT_THINKING_EFFORT (lib/constants) imported by both the panel and use-chat - net: the feature reuses three existing mechanisms instead of adding parallel ones.

Only the latest custom model is remembered (single value, matching the UI copy); no list management or validation of the typed name - a typo fails per-turn at the provider and can be replaced by typing a new name.
New file .claude/launch.json (frontend-dev on port 3001) added for browser verification because compose port 3000 serves a baked image, not the working tree; kept for future sessions.

Deliberately not taken: flipping backend AI_THINKING_ENABLED/AI_THINKING_EFFORT instead - that would change every API client and stay invisible in the panel without a server-default handshake; scoped to the chat UI the user asked about.
reason: The Model tab only offers the models baked into AI_AVAILABLE_MODELS, which lags what OpenRouter actually serves, so a model missing from the list is unusable without a repo edit even though the WebSocket already forwards any model string unvalidated; and the thinking-effort default of 'off' means every chat silently runs without reasoning unless the user remembers to raise it, when 'high' is the wanted default.
rollback: git revert restores all behaviour. A revert does not remove the persisted customModel value users have saved under the chat-mode localStorage key in their browsers; the reverted store simply ignores the extra key, so no cleanup is required.
security_impact: None deliberately: the free-text model name is client state sent over the existing authenticated WS 'model' field, which the backend already forwarded unvalidated to OpenRouter (agent_session.py passes data.get('model') through); no new input reaches a query or shell, and nothing is rendered from it beyond the user's own text.
summary: Controls window: free-text custom model entry and default thinking effort high
